# Complete Water4Energy workbench Mac package · v0.15.1

[Download the complete Mac ZIP](Water4Energy-Workbench-v0.15.1-All-in-One-Mac.zip?raw=true) · [SHA256 checksum](Water4Energy-Workbench-v0.15.1-All-in-One-Mac.zip.sha256)

1. Download and extract **Water4Energy-Workbench-v0.15.1-All-in-One-Mac.zip**.
2. Open the extracted **TVA-Workbench** folder.
3. Double-click **Start TVA Workbench.command**. Keep Terminal open and follow the printed browser URL.

The ZIP contains the interface, VISTA project setup, eight saved-evidence skills, nine lead documents, source references and saved April evidence. It is the complete published archive, not a placeholder or a link to an external backend bundle. No separate setup bundle is needed.

VISTA must be installed, and each recipient configures their own model/provider credentials in VISTA Settings. The launcher prepares **Water4Energy-TVA-agent-loop** through the local VISTA API before opening the interface. Existing unrecognized or locally modified backend items are preserved; follow any setup message printed by the launcher. Keep all extracted files together.

The repository's **Water4Energy-Workbench/** directory is the source checkout, which connects to an existing project without automatically installing the bundled science payload. Use the ZIP above for the combined first-time setup.
